A SEPARATE Railway service (not the backend service above), same repo/root directory/Dockerfile, but overriding the start command to run pending migrations once and exit -- mirrors docker-compose.prod.yml's `migrate` profile, since Railway has no native pre-deploy/release-phase hook to rely on without live testing. Trigger a redeploy of THIS service manually before redeploying `backend` whenever a commit adds a migration; it needs no public domain and no restart-on-success. The start command is the compiled entry point (node dist/migrate.js, A-19): `npm run migrate` drives the typeorm CLI through ts-node, which `npm ci --omit=dev` leaves out of this image.
